privacyBody:
## Overview
Paimorn ("we", "our", the "Service") is a community songbook for guitar chords and lyrics. This page explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using Paimorn, you agree to the practices described here.

## Information We Collect
- Account information: when you create an account, we store the email address you provide and a display name, plus a profile photo if you choose to upload one. Your password is handled directly by Firebase Authentication — we never see it in plain text.
- Content you submit: song titles, artists, lyrics, chords, comments, setlists, favorites, song requests, and issue reports you create are stored so the Service can show them to you and, where applicable, to other users.
- Song requests: if you request a song, the email address and Facebook link you provide are stored privately and shown only to site admins — never publicly. The song title/artist, lyrics, and vote count you submit in a request are public so others can vote on it.
- Local device data: your language and theme preference, and a short list of recently viewed songs, are stored on your own device (browser local storage) and never sent to us. The app also caches song content on your device so you can keep reading recently viewed songs while offline.
- Microphone (guitar tuner): if you use the built-in tuner, the app (Android) accesses your device's microphone to detect pitch in real time. Audio is processed entirely on your device and is never recorded to a file, stored, or sent to our servers.
- Analytics: we use Google Analytics to see roughly how many people are browsing the site right now and which countries visitors are browsing from (estimated by Google from IP address — we do not store your exact IP address ourselves). Google Analytics does not receive your name, email, or any other account information from us. We do not use advertising trackers.

## How We Use Your Information
We use the information above to operate the Service: to show your submissions in the songbook once approved, let you manage your own setlists, favorites, and profile, let admins review submissions and moderate reported issues, and contact you about a song request if you left details for that purpose.

## Public vs. Private Content
Approved songs, comments, community posts, song requests (excluding your contact details), and their vote counts are visible to anyone who visits the site — please don't put anything in these fields that you don't want public. Your setlists and favorites are private to your account by default; a setlist is visible to others only if you turn on its "Share" link yourself.

## Data Storage & Security
Paimorn runs on Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication, Firebase Storage, Cloud Functions), so your data is stored on Google's cloud infrastructure. Access to non-public data — like your account email or a song request's contact details — is restricted by server-side security rules to you and to site admins only.

## Analytics
We use Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google, to understand traffic and usage on this site. Google Analytics has its own privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy) and offers a browser add-on to opt out of its tracking across all websites (tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).

## Your Choices
You can edit your display name and profile photo, delete your own draft songs, and remove your own comments, setlists, or favorites at any time inside the app. If you'd like your account and its data deleted entirely, email us below and we'll take care of it.

## Children's Privacy
Paimorn is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

## Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy as the Service changes. If we make a material change, we'll update the "Last updated" date above.

## Contact Us
Questions about this policy or your data? Email us at hseng2018@gmail.com.
termsBody:
## Overview
By creating an account or using Paimorn ("we", "our", the "Service"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you don't agree, please don't use the Service.

## Your Account
You're responsible for keeping your password secure and for anything that happens under your account. You must provide accurate information when creating an account, and you may not share an account with others or create one to impersonate someone else.

## Content You Submit
When you submit a song, lyrics, chords, a comment, a song request, or anything else to Paimorn, you keep ownership of it, but you grant us a license to display, store, and distribute it on the Service (including transposed/reformatted versions) for as long as it remains published. You confirm you have the right to share what you submit — don't submit lyrics/chords you don't have permission to share, or content that infringes someone else's copyright.

## Moderation
All song submissions are reviewed by an admin before appearing publicly, and may be edited, rejected, or removed at any time — including after approval — if they violate these Terms, contain incorrect information, or are reported as a copyright/content issue. Comments, song requests, and community posts may also be removed at our discretion.

## Acceptable Use
Don't use Paimorn to submit spam, harassment, illegal content, or anything designed to disrupt the Service. Don't attempt to access another user's account, bypass moderation, or interfere with the Service's normal operation.

## Account Termination
We may suspend or delete an account that violates these Terms, without notice. You can stop using the Service, or ask us to delete your account and its data (see the Privacy Policy), at any time.

## No Warranty
Paimorn is provided "as is" — chord and lyric accuracy depends on contributors, and we don't guarantee the Service will always be available, error-free, or exactly as described. Use your own judgment, especially for anything performance-critical.

## Changes to These Terms
We may update these Terms as the Service changes. Continuing to use Paimorn after a change means you accept the updated Terms.

## Contact Us
Questions about these Terms? Email us at hseng2018@gmail.com.
guideIntro: A quick tour of everything you can do here.
guideSongbookDesc: Browse songs by artist, filter by category or musical key, or search by song name — even by a lyric you remember.
guideSearchDesc: Press Ctrl+K anywhere to jump straight to a song by name, artist, or a line from its lyrics.
guideTunerDesc: Tune your guitar using your device's microphone, or tap a string to hear its reference pitch.
guideChordsDesc: Look up any chord's finger positions, or test yourself with the chord quiz.
guideSetlistsDesc: Group songs for a gig or practice session, reorder them by dragging, and share a link so bandmates can view it without logging in.
guideFavoritesDesc: Tap the heart on any song to save it here for quick access later.
guideCommunityDesc: Start a discussion, comment on others', and climb the Top Contributors list.
guideSubmitDesc: Add a song's lyrics and chords yourself — an admin reviews it before it goes live. Track your submissions under My Songs.
guideRequestDesc: Don't know the chords? Send us the lyrics and we'll work them out — or vote on requests other people have sent in.
guideReportDesc: Spotted a wrong chord or lyric on a song? Use the report button on its page to let us know.
guideInstallDesc: Install Paimorn on your phone's home screen for quick, app-like access — look for the Install card on the Home page.
guideLanguageDesc: Tap the globe icon in the top bar to switch between English, Thai, Shan, and Burmese.

aboutMission:
Rooted in our own love for music,
we want our songs to keep up with the times
— technology included —
so that our fellow Shan people who enjoy playing guitar and singing
can do it more easily.
That's why we set out to build this songbook app,
or rather, this music songbook.
